items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won’t go.
items.why: Hamstring; no practice, sources confirm low optimism.

items.text: Rams get Puka Nacua back as Eagles prepare without DeVonta Smith; Nacua expected to play Week 4.
items.why: Progress in practice; McVay expects return from groin/hip.
items.implication: Elite WR1 back in lineup vs PHI.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; out at least 4 games (eligible Week 9 after bye).
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirmed IR designation.
items.implication: Out minimum 4 games; committee backfield ahead.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries open for remaining backs

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (TNF): 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; top-10 play, believe despite short week.
items.why: Elite usage; CLE allows big RB games; Dowdle likely out again.

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full practice Thursday.
items.implication: Both locked in as QB1/WR1 for Week 4.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 YPG with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry elite; high target share confirmed.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice from PUP.
items.why: Designated return; limited practice Thursday after ACL.
items.implication: Could activate as early as Week 5; impacts SEA RB depth.
items.opportunity: Potential RB snaps for Charbonnet soon; monitor Price/Wilson

items.text: Fresh ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker ranked 3rd overall notable near top.
items.why: ETR ROS top-150 update factors injuries/roles/schedule.
items.implication: Elite RB1 ROS value in new KC role.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% career target share/34 YPG with Penix; under 8 pts in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization.
items.why: Historical underperformance with Penix; low utilization.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson (36% share w/o Mitchell), Josh Downs (31% share/43% RZ), George Kittle (climbing share, Evans day-to-day).
items.why: Target share spikes and matchup/injury boosts.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low util/target/route, SEA tough), Emeka Egbuka (new QB, low RZ, low total), Xavier Worthy (shrinking share vs Rice).
items.why: Poor usage metrics and tough spots/QB change.

items.text: Prefer Jonathan Taylor side of Flowers + Montgomery for JT trade; want the '1' in close 2-for-1.
items.why: ETR trade calculator and preference for clear RB1.

items.text: Texans run game broken forever across coaches/RBs/OL; 27th in YPC 2026 after years of bottom ranks. Ignore more work rumors.
items.why: Historical YPC ranks show structural issue, not personnel.
items.implication: Fade HOU RBs regardless of workload claims.
items.opportunity: Low efficiency carries even if volume rises

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst relative to opportunity.
items.why: Low targets/aDOT despite opportunity; chart of underperformers.
items.implication: Avoid or bench; volume not converting.
